_doc: Step 4B M2 direction step: the fixed niche taxonomy (kept as proposed by Huraira, 2026-10-01, docs/FRONTEND-UPGRADE-DESIGN.md §10), the two build tracks, and the conversion goals the direction agent may choose from. Versioned data read by packages/planning/src/direction.ts. `leaningTrack` is the usual fit, a hint only: the agent weighs the whole request, and the owner always chooses. Change a list = bump version.

niches.label: Local trade
niches.description: Roofers, plumbers, electricians, builders, cleaners, landscapers and other trades serving a local area.

niches.label: Local health
niches.description: Dentists, physios, clinics, vets and other local health or wellness practices.

niches.label: Hospitality
niches.description: Restaurants, cafes, bars, hotels, venues and caterers.

niches.label: Professional services
niches.description: Accountants, lawyers, consultants, agencies selling a service to businesses or individuals.

niches.label: Brand or product
niches.description: Product launches, consumer brands, software products and premium or lifestyle brands.

niches.label: Creative portfolio
niches.description: Studios, designers, photographers, artists and makers showing their work.

niches.label: Other
niches.description: Anything that does not fit the categories above.

tracks.A: Local business, conversion-first: multi-page static site, fast on weak mobile signal, click-to-call, quote/booking forms, local search basics.
tracks.B: Motion-rich brand site: Next.js static export, scroll-driven motion and rich sections, premium feel.
